about_the_game:
Neverending AI Storybook is your personal AI-powered storyteller, generating unique tales, stunning illustrations, and interactive choices based on your input. No two adventures are ever the same!

Privacy-first storytelling—no limits, no internet, just adventure.

Shape your own adventure with a local AI that crafts fully customized stories, complete with AI-generated images and dynamic choices—100% private with no internet required.

A book that never ends—unless you want it to.

This isn’t just a game—it’s an infinite story generator. With every page, the AI unveils a new chapter, complete with artwork and choices, making each playthrough an entirely new experience.

AI-powered storytelling, built for you.

Ever wished a story could adapt to your imagination? In Neverending AI Storybook, the AI reacts to your ideas, crafting unique tales with stunning illustrations at every turn.

  • One moment, you’re a pirate captain navigating treacherous waters; the next, an interstellar traveler uncovering the secrets of an alien world. What will your next adventure be?

  • With every decision you make, the AI weaves a deeper narrative, ensuring no two journeys are alike.

  • Don’t just read a story—become part of an ever-expanding world that reshapes itself with every page!

  • Whether you want a relaxing bedtime tale or an epic fantasy saga,
    Neverending AI Storybook delivers an experience that feels handcrafted just for you.

Infinite Storytelling Possibilities

  • Every session is a brand-new adventure—AI dynamically generates unique stories based on your input.

  • Choose from preset story genres or create something entirely original.

  • Your choices matter! Pick from three suggested actions or type your own to shape the narrative however you like.

AI-Generated Illustrations

  • Watch as the game paints a scene for every page, using AI-generated imagery to match the unfolding story.

  • From medieval castles to dystopian wastelands, each setting is brought to life with unique AI-crafted visuals.

Unparalleled Freedom & Interactivity

  • Make decisions in two ways: pick from AI-suggested paths or write your own action to drive the story forward.

  • No restrictions—your actions and creativity shape the tale in unexpected ways.

  • Play as a hero, villain, wanderer, or something else entirely—it’s up to you!

Offline & Private – Your Stories Stay Yours

  • Runs entirely locally on your machine—no online servers, no data collection, no tracking.

  • Your adventures are 100% private, ensuring that your creativity remains yours alone.

  • No subscriptions, no microtransactions—just unlimited storytelling at your fingertips.

Pick the AI model that fits your system

Neverending AI Storybook scales to fit your hardware. Whether you have a mid-range gaming laptop or a high-end desktop, you can select the AI model that balances speed, creativity, and accuracy.

✔ 8GB VRAM (RTX 2060, RX 6600 or better) – Runs smaller models for quick storytelling.

✔ 12GB+ VRAM (RTX 3060, 3070, or better) – A great balance of quality and speed.

✔ 24GB+ VRAM (RTX 4090, 3090, or equivalent) – For the most expressive AI-generated stories.

No need for cloud servers or subscriptions—everything runs right on your machine.
Just pick a model that fits your setup and start generating stories!

No matter your hardware, Neverending AI Storybook has a model that works for you.
The game intelligently scales from mid-range GPUs to cutting-edge AI hardware,
so you can enjoy fast, private, and limitless storytelling at any level.

content_descriptors.notes:
Neverending AI Storybook utilizes private local AI-generated content, meaning the storylines and scenarios are created dynamically based on player input in a private manner. The default content generated by the AI is generally mild and tame—suitable for a wide audience. However, since the game allows you to craft your own stories and interact with the AI in various ways, the content can become as mature or explicit as you choose.

You have full control over the narrative, and you can guide the story into darker, more mature themes—such as violence, adult content, and sensitive topics—based on your decisions, actions, and written input. While the AI can create content that responds to your inputs, please note that if players choose to explore themes such as extreme violence, substance abuse, sexual abuse, or other mature subject matter, the game will guide the story away from these themes.

We also impose certain content restrictions to ensure a safe and respectful experience for all players. The game does not allow for extremes such as the glorification of suicide, hate speech, content involving sexualization of underage characters, sexual assault, and more. These themes are strictly prohibited within the game, and the AI will not generate such content.

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB Dedicated VRAM (RTX 2060, RX 6600, or better) – Supports smaller AI models for faster performance.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
